result.title: PathJev: Decision-Native Vision-Language Modelling for Histopathology
result.comment: 25 pages, 4 figures. Code: https://github.com/CosmoIknosLab/PathJev ; model and demo: https://huggingface.co/Cristiandieti/PathJev-P
result.summary: Vision-language models used for decisions in histopathology rarely return calibrated probabilities over the candidates a user cares about. Decision-native models write a question and a candidate set chosen at run time into the input and return a normalised distribution from a small decision head in one forward pass. We build PathJev-P, a decision-native model for histopathology: MedGemma-1.5-4B with LoRA adapters and a decision head, trained on 40,000 patch states from three public collections whose expert labels are turned into typed questions with organ-specific candidate sets and a "none of these" option. In a comparison over 3 seeds with an analysis plan fixed before testing, on test sets without documented overlap with the training data of the backbone, PathJev-P is more accurate than a generative model trained with the same backbone, data and selection rule, the zero-shot pathology model CONCH and a general medical decision model (balanced accuracy 0.541 against 0.492, 0.345 and 0.213); its advantage over the generative model comes from two organs absent from training. The calibration advantage depends on how the generative model's probabilities are read out. With the summed candidate log-likelihood used in previous work, PathJev-P has the lower calibration error (ECE 0.204 against 0.279); with a length-normalised read-out of the same generative model, examined post hoc, the two have similar mean calibration error (0.201) and the generative model is better calibrated on the unseen organs, where PathJev-P remains over-confident. A supervised linear probe on a pathology foundation model is better calibrated in every setting. In a qualitative whole-slide demonstration, PathJev-P labels unsupervised tissue clusters with abstention and separates carcinoma from other tissue while running the model on a fraction of the tiles.

AI.brief_summary: 该文提出组织病理学 decision-native 模型 PathJev-P：把问题与运行时候选集写入输入，由小型决策头在一次前向中输出归一化概率，并与生成式基线、CONCH 等比较平衡准确率、校准及弃答表现。
AI.relevance_reason: 其候选集决策头与「none of these」弃答机制可能为 LVR 的停止决策和答案读出/校准提供核查线索，但论文未涉及 latent 推理状态、视觉证据获取或动态计算。
